Brought into red_ namespace. ; ; ; ;- function red_findthedim, ny, maxs res = 0L for ii = 1L, maxs do begin if((ny / ii) * ii EQ ny) then res = ii endfor print, 'findthedim: using ny1 = '+string(res, format='(I5)') return, res end
